tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro chu dug gdong nag po'i las byang gdug pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha 'jam dpal ya mānta ka la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dir bcom ldan 'das rigs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed khro chu dug gdong nag po'i las byang phrin las kyi rim pa ni: lha mchog 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par mnos shing*/ lugs dang lag len gdams pa'i gnad ma lus pa dpal ldan bla ma dgyes pa'i ngang nas bstsal ba: de dag kyang yin rlom du ma lus par bslab sbyangs kyis rang byan tshud par byas pa'i sgrub pa pos gnas dus yo byad sogs bca' gzhi lag len shog dril du bshad pa ltar| bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi skabs su gang bab kyi yo byad ma tshang ba med pa nye bar 'du byas la/ sgrub pa po kha lhor phyogs pas bde ba'i stan la byang chub kyi sems gnyis sngon du btang nas/ de'ang tho rangs kyi cha'am snga thun la bdag nyid gshin rje tshe bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du btang na shin tu legs shing*/ de'i ngang nas slar yang dang po 'jam dpal khro chu'i bdag gi rnal 'byor sgom pa sngon du 'gro ba'i slad du: skyabs su 'gro ba ni: skyabs yul rtsa ba gsum dang*/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po tha mi dad pa mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab la: hūm̐ */ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar: bla ma lha dang dkon mchog rin chen gsum: gshin rje'i gshed po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: zhes gsum dang*/ slar sems bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ */ snang grag chos rnams rang bzhin med pa la: de ltar ma rtogs sems can snying re rje: de phyir bdag ni gshin rje'i gshed gyur pas: de dag sangs rgyas sa la 'god par bya: zhes gsum brjod/ de nas bgegs la gtor ma spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs shing byin la: bka' bsgo ba ni/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal khros pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas: e ya: yang gsang rigs gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du:

'du ba'i mched lcam dam ldan ma gtogs pa: dam med bdud bgegs log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: lan chags gtor ma 'di khyer rang gnas dengs: gal te mi 'gro gnas 'dir 'dug gyur na: dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yi: sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i khro chen tshogs: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun bkang nas: bgegs tshogs 'dul zhing brlag par gdon mi za: du tri ya ma rā dzaḥsogs rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs kyi sngags btags pas bgegs bskrad la: mtshams gcod pa ni: e ya: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i thugs kyi 'od zer las: khro bo khro mo 'khor lo ral gri dang : rdo rje phur bu dgra sta tho ba mdung : rtse gsum gri gug me dang mdung la sogs: 'bar ba'i mtshon thogs pho nya'i tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs gnod byed gdon tshogs mtshams chod cig: bsrung ba'i ra gur mi shigs rdo rje'i mkhar: rlung yang rgyu ba'i go skabs ma mchis na: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad ming yang med: gnyis 'dzin bgegs tshogs rang rig rang shar te: de ltar rtogs na bgegs rnams rang sar grol: 'khor 'das mnyam nyid chos skur ngang gis grub: ces pa rtsa sngags mjug tu/ ya ma rā dza nirmā ṇa ma hā kro dha dzwa la tsakra khaḍga ya kī la ya parshu mutga ra shu la tri shū la karta ri agni sa ra dzā la pra kā ra rakṣa ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa: ces mtshams bcad: de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni: oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs kyi sngags kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bhandha'i snod lcang lor bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dgra bgegs gnod byed gdug pa can bsgral ba'i phung po las byung ba'i khrag chen gyi yon chab/ dbang po'i me tog /sha chen gyi bdug spos/ tshil chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ tsitta'i zhal zas/ rkang gling dang thod rnga'i rol mo la sogs pa drag po'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥham̐'u/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ āḥhūm̐/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ/ gandhaṃ| nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad/ zhes so sor sbyar la byin gyis brlabs/ bdud rtsi bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bcud sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin kha dog dri ro reg bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes sngags gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: rakta bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las dgra bgegs gnod byed byad ma'i thod pa rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa skra dang bcas pa yangs shing rgya che ba gan rkyal du phyogs pa'i nang du/ srid gsum dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams dang lha srin sde brgyad 'byung po bsgral ba'i snying khrag rnams dug chen gyis sbags pa'i rakta'i rgya mtsho lbu phreng rba rlabs phyogs bcur 'phyo zhing yongs su gang bas las kyi gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed nus par gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrī ṭhāḥ zhes gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las bhandha'i snod lcang lor bcas pa'i gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du nṛ dang tri las dgra bgegs gnod byed spyi dang*/ khyad par dmigs pa'i dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i gzugs phung sha khrag gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba lingta te dzwa ba lingta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de rnams ni sngon du 'gro ba'i las rim mo: de nas dngos gzhi sa mā dhi dgu skor gyis bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par bsgom pa ni:

hūm̐ */ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal: snying rje'i rtsal du rang byung khro tshogs gsal: e las rab 'jigs nam mkha' mtha' dbus med: 'khor ba'i 'dam skem ye shes bskal me dang : 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho snying rje'i chu rgyun gyi: tsha grang dbyer med rab tu 'jigs par 'khrugs: steng gi phyogs ni ral gri'i lding khang la: 'og kyang spu gri chen po'i sa gzhir gdal: bar du mtshon cha sna tshogs bu yug 'tshubs: de yi dbus su nang ni lcags bsregs la: phyi ru mtshon cha bsnol ba'i gzhal yas khang : de'i phyir thod pa'i gur khang zlum po la: dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor: ha la'i gur khang gru bzhi rba rlabs 'phyo: rlung gi spu gri g.yon 'khor gru gsum 'bar: phyi ni khro chu'i gur khang sra mkhregs brtan: de las bskal pa'i me chen rab tu 'bar: zhes pa gur khang brgyad kyi srung ba ste: gzugs kyi shog dril gyi don no: de nang zlog byed khro bo gnag cing 'tsher: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mtshon cha sna tshogs gdengs: grangs med sprul pas dgra bgegs byad ma rnams: zlog cing bsregs pas thal ba rdul du rlog: de'i nang khro bo dkar po zhal gsum pa: phyag drug dang po'i tshe bum bdud rtsis bkang : bar pa gnam lcags 'khor los tshe bdud zlog: tha ma byang sems rgyun 'bab thod pa bsnams: rang 'dra'i khro bo du mas sngags sgra sgrog: srung zhing skyob pa'i las ni phun tshogs mdzad: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar: bar gcod dgra bgegs bdud dpung mtshams chod cig: ces pa ni khro bo dkar nag gi srung ba ste: mig gi shog dril gyi don no: gur khang gzhal yas chen po de nyid du: ma traṃ bsgral ba'i chos dbyings drag po'i zhing : gshin rje'i grong khyer e mthing bsnol pa'i dbus: mtshon cha sna tshogs dug phur khri steng du: padma nyi zla ma he gshin rje dang :

sde brgyad bdud dang mu stegs ban sngags bon: phyi nang yi dam chos skyong dregs byed gtso: dgra bgegs pho mo gan rkyal kha sbubs steng : bdag nyid skad cig rdzus skyes rdo rje'i sku: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sprul pa: snang srid kun gyi bcud 'dus khro bo'i rgyal: 'jam dpal las kyi gshin rje dmar nag khrag rul lta bu 'tsher: g.yas ljang g.yon dmar dbus nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa: spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcu'i bgegs la gzir: bstan pa'i dgra la khro 'khrugs rngam pa'i zhal: mche ba bcu gnyis dug phur 'bar ba gtams: ljags 'dril drag po'i rkan rdeb dgra bgegs gsol: rdzi smin sma ra ag tshom dbu skra rnams: dmar ser gyen brdzes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: dbu steng dug lcags khro chu'i mchod rten nang : rigs gsum mgon g.yas phyag rdor dang g.yon rta mgrin dbus 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dus gsum sangs rgyas g.yas mar me mdzad g.yon byams pa dbus shākya thub pa bzhugs: zlog pa'i dus tshig 'di'i tshab tu gshin rje rta mgrin bya khyung rnam gsum la: dus gsum rgyal ba yi dam zhi khros bskor: zhes pa'i tshig gnyis 'jug go// 'di ni dbu rgyan zlog sgyur ba zlog pa'i shog dril gyi don no/ mchan/ dbu gsum thod skam lnga lnga rin po che'i: rtse bran dang bcas dar gyi cod pan 'phur: g.yas gsum dgra stas nyams pa'i mgo lus phral: g.yon gsum tsitta srog rtsar bcas pa 'drad: spu gri ral gri'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gyis: byad ma dgra bgegs bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod: sde brgyad dregs pa'i mgo bcad do shal byas: dug sbrul 'bar ba dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: srid rtse mnar med khyab pa sku yi khyon: lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma zla ba 'char: ba spu'i bu ga rang 'dra'i khro bos gtams: lto bar srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi:

grong khyer bcas shing skye 'gro khram la 'debs: sku sked chu srin rngam zhal 'bar ba yis: stong gsum gsol zhing phur bu sbrul chun 'phyo: dgra bgegs srog gzir dwangs ma 'dren par byed: sku skyes dug mes gdug pa'i tshogs rnams sreg: khro chung tshogs spros dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: gsang yum gsang ba dun tig nag mo ni: zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i cha byad can: mche ba bzhi gtsigs spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad: ral pa kham nag srid pa'i rtse mor snyegs: phyag g.yas dang po ral gris dgra srog gcod: 'og ma lcags kyus dgra bgegs bla srog 'gugs: g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag yab la stob: 'og mas lcags sgrog gnod byed bla sems 'ching : zhabs gnyis yab kyi lte bar 'khril sbyor tshul: rang 'od las byung sbas pa'i tshul du gsal: mdun du sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po dang : g.yas zur gsung sprul tshe bdag sku mdog dmar: g.yon zur thugs sprul srog bdag mthing nag mdog: g.yas su yon tan be wa sa ta dud: rgyab tu phrin las za ba ljang dmar rnams: g.yas pa dgra stas nyams pa'i srog rtsa gcod: g.yon pa dgra snying dmar po zas su rol: g.yon du gnyis med sprul pa gshin rje'i gshed: ya ma rā dza dud mdog chu srin gdong : g.yas pa ral gris nyams pa'i mgo lus phral: g.yon pa sbrul zhag dgra bgegs bla srog 'ching : de ltar 'khor gyi gshin rje sde drug po: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngam: glang chen ko rlon zhing chen sbrul gyis brgyan: sku smad phur bu nyams pa'i snying la gzir: rdzu 'phrul gshog pas bar snang khams su rgyug: za byed zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: sma ra ag tshom khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus: khros pa'i sdang mig dmar zlum gyen du bgrad: ral pa kham nag srid pa'i rtse mor 'bar: thod pa skam rlon rin chen rus pas brgyan: de'i phyir mdun du las kyi bshan pa ni:

spyi gshed dug gdong nag po khro bo'i rje: g.yas pa zhe sdang seng zhal mkha' la 'phyo: g.yon pa gti mug phag zhal thur du bsgrad: dbus zhal 'dod chags chu srin rngam pa'i tshul: ya 'gal gnam la mas 'gal sa gzhir bsgrad: lce ni bar snang glog ltar phyogs brgyar g.yo: mche ba bcu gnyis gangs ri lta bur gtsigs: sku mdog nag po srid pa'i rtse dang mnyam: khro rngam 'bar ba dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: sku smad phur bu nyams pa'i snying la gzir: rdzu 'phrul gshog pas stong gsum yud kyis bskor: za byed zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: sma ra ag tshom khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus: khros pa'i sdang mig dmar zlum phyogs bcur gzigs: ral pa se yan srid rtser me 'bar 'phyo: phyag drug g.yas gsum ral gris dgra srog gcod: g.yon gsum sbrul nag zhags pas dgra bgegs 'ching : phyi 'khor las kyi gshin rje'i dmag gi tshogs: gshed chen sde bzhi bdud po sde bzhi dang : 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dregs pa sgo ba bzhi: srog gcod ru tra sde bzhir bcas pa dang : pho gshed mo gshed bdun brgya nyi shu'i 'khor: bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs bcas phyogs bcur rgyug: kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchong stabs rngam: khro gtum sha la sred cing khrag la rol: ma bskul bar yang gang la bya shes nas: spyi dgos bstan pa'i ru tra zhe la gnon: mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas sgrub pa po'i: re ba skong zhing bar chad dgra bgegs 'joms: kun gyi gnas gsum yi ges mtshan pa las: 'od 'phros ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: zhes pa ni lha bskyed pa ste: srung ba me'i shog dril gyi don no: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: sbyar ba'i spos dang gu gul bsreg: rnga dung cha lang la sogs rol mo'i sgra du ma dang bcas dbyangs snyan po'i 'di skad do: e ya: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na: las kyi gshin rje'i zhing khams nas:

tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mtshon cha bsnol ba'i gur khang nas: dregs byed 'bum gyi khri steng du: padma nyi zla dgra bgegs gdan: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: bde gshegs kun gyi sprul pa ste: ya mānta ka'i sku yi sras: las kyi gshin rje ma rungs pa: rigs gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du: drag po'i pho brang dam pa 'dir: spyan 'dren mchod phyir gshegs su gsol: khro chu dug gdong gshegs su gsol: gsang yum dun tig gshegs su gsol: 'chi bdag nag po gshegs su gsol: tshe bdag nag po gshegs su gsol: srog bdag nag po gshegs su gsol: be wa sa ta gshegs su gsol: za ba ljang dmar gshegs su gsol: ya ma rā tsa gshegs su gsol: spyi gshed dug gdong gshegs su gsol: gshed chen bdud po 'chi bdag dang : ru tra sgo ba la sogs pa: bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa'i 'khor: bstan pa gnyan po bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol: phyi nang chos skyong 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: lha srin sde brgyad 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: byad ma rbod gtong bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: rgyal 'gong dam sri 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: pe the'u bsen mo 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gza' klu the'u rang 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: byad ma phur kha bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong phyir gshegs su gsol: rkyen ngan bar chad sel phyir gshegs su gsol: mchog thun dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub phyir gshegs su gsol: ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dza dza dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs la ye shes pa rnams skad cig gis byon te dam tshig pa la chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du 'dres par bsam: bzhugs su gsol ba ni:

hūm̐ */ ma rungs ru tra bsgral ba'i gzhal yas khang : byad ma dgra bgegs nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rab 'jigs khro rgyal yab yum 'khor dang bcas: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: du tri ya ma rā dza sogs rtsa sngags mjug tu: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: zhes bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal ba ni: e/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed che: sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas rnams la: bdag cag rig 'dzin rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o: ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra pā da banda naṃ ka ro mi: zhes phyag 'tshal la: mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ */ lha mchog ya mānta ka 'khor bcas la: khrag gi arghaṃ dbang po'i me tog dang : sha chen spos dang zhun chen snang gsal dang : mkhris pa'i dri chab tsitta'i zhal zas dang : thod rnga rkang gling rol mor bcas pa 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhes su gsol: zhes dang rtsa ba'i sngags mjug tu/ arghaṃ nas shapada'i bar btags pas phul/ de nas bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bdud rtsi gtor mar bsgron la: hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sbyar ba'i sman: 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms shing rigs lnga'i dngos: ye shes lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi'i bcud chen 'di: 'jam dpal gshin rje shākya seng ge dang : nyan thos sde dang rig 'dzin padma 'byung : ba su dha ra sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs: gter ston zhang khrom zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: don yod rdo rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang : karma si tu ka bzhi pa chen po: nyi ma bcu drug pa dang kun dga'i zhabs: byang chub dpal mo'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: tshul khrims rgya mtsho gung rad tshul khrims rgya mtsho rje btsun ratnas gshin rje khro chu'i gsan pa gnang yul yin no// gnam lcags me 'bar dang :

bkra shis mtshan dang du ma rang grol dang : mi bskyod rdo rje rtsal sogs khro chu yi: dbang lung brgyud pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan yang ya wa shaka rdor sras a dbang : rig 'dzin 'di la'ang rje ratnas gsan pa rje gong ma man chad gong dang 'dra gsang ba'i bar du brgyud pa yi: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gzhan 'di gnyis ka gung rad dngos slob yin yang brtson 'grus mtshan dang gser pa dang : rigs sngags 'chang ba padma'i mtshan 'di'i drung du lung dang lag len tshang ma zhus la sogs: 'jam dpal sman gdong dug gdong rtsa brgyud kyi: bla ma slob dpon zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes gshin rje 'di nyid brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba gsum la 'bul zhing*/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ */ yab gcig dpal chen khro chu dug gdong dang : gsang ba'i yum chen gsang ba dun tig ma: sku sprul 'chi bdag gsung sprul tshe yi bdag: thugs sprul srog bdag zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: yon tan sprul pa be wa sa ta dang : phrin las sprul pa za ba ljang dmar dang : gnyis med sprul pa ya ma rā dza dang : spyi gshed shan pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: gshed chen sde bzhi bdud po sde bzhi dang : 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dregs pa sgo ba bzhi: pho gshed mo gshed sha za khrag 'thung sogs: sde brgyad dmag tshogs zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes dang*/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags mjug tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: btags la bdud rtsi thig gtor gyis 'bul zhing*/ slar yang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lā bi kā la bi kā la rā tri tā ḍoṃ bhi nī tsaṇḍa lī rakṣa sī siṅga lī de wī oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā kā lā kā lī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes sogs rang gang byed kyi chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi rtsa sngags gsham du yi ge gsum btags la bdud rtsi thigs gtor gyis phul la: oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes bdud rtsi rang gi khar myong zhing dngos grub blang :

de nas dug khrag gi mchod pa ni: bhandha'i snod kyi dug khrag sbreng zhing gtor mar bsgron la: hūm̐ */ las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor bcas la: dug khrag bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: steng phyogs lha rnams bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: 'og phyogs klu rnams bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: bar snang gza' rnams bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: nag po bdud rnams bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: dmar po btsan rnams bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: pho rgyud mo rgyud bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: sde brgyad 'byung po bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: gnod byed bgegs rnams bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs log lta bsgral ba'i rakta dang : bhandha'i snod du dug khrag rgya mtsho 'di: 'chi med sman dang bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa:

rakta'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol: zhes yab yum gyi rtsa sngags mjug tu: ma hā rakta pū dza khā hi: zhes dbul/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: rdo rje'i thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi ljags 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ ces mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum brjod la/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags mjug tu/ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi: dgra bgegs byad ma dmigs pa'i yul du gyur pa rnams kyi don snying lnga la kha raṃ khā hi: srog rtsa khrag rtsa snying rtsa la kha raṃ khā hi: skye mched gzugs phung rnam shes la kha raṃ khā hi: dbugs bla srog tshe bkrag mdangs la kha raṃ khā hi: sha khrag rkang klad khu ba zhag dang chu ser pags rus rnams la kha raṃ khā hi: byad ma dgra bgegs kyi mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi: dgra bgegs lha srung ban sngags bon skyong srung byed rim gro mkhan rnams la kha raṃ khā hi: byad ma dgra bgegs kyi skye ba bdun rgyud dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi: dgra bgegs kyi rjes shul bu tsha rigs rgyud pho mo dgu rgyud rtsa ba dang bcas pa la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes lan nyer gcig gam bdun gyis phul la/ dgra bgegs dmigs bya'i sha khrag gzugs phung bla srog dang bcas pa thams cad gshin rje 'khor bcas kyis hab di ri ri dgyes shing tshims pa'i rkan sgra dang bcas pas bzhes te: mnyes shing tshims nas phrin las gang bcol ba thams cad myur du mdzad par bsam: skabs 'dir bsnyen sgrub las sbyor srung zlog bsad mnan gang yin gyi 'dod gsol dang dmod bcol rgyas pa'ang bya'o: de nas lha tshogs rnams la bstod pa ni: e ya: phyogs bstod pa 'di la phyogs bcu ma chung bar grags so// bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: padma nyi zla dregs byed gdan steng du: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs:

rnam 'phrul sku gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje mthu bo che: sku mdog dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: zhal gsum g.yas ljang phyag rdor dregs pa 'dul: g.yon dmar rta mgrin dbang chen khros pa'i zhal: dbus mthing 'jam dbyangs drag pos dgra bgegs sgrol: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu yi rgyan du byas: spyan dgu dmar zlum sdang mig gyen thur gzigs: mche ba bcu gnyis dug phur 'bar bas gtams: phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra stas ru tra sgrol: g.yon gsum nyams pa'i tsitta zhal du gsol: spu gri ral gri 'bar ba'i gshog pa gdengs: sked pa chu srin rngam zhal stong gsum rngub: sku smad gnam lcags phur bus dgra bgegs gzir: ba spu'i gseb nas rang 'dra'i khro bo 'gyed: sku las ye shes me dpung rab tu 'phro: dur khrod rus pa'i chas kyis sku la brgyan: gsang yum sbas pa'i tshul gyis sku la 'khril: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las dang : gnyis med sprul pa'i 'chi bdag tshe bdag dang : srog bdag be wa sa ta za ba ljang : ya ma rā tsa spyi gshed shan pa sogs: sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas la bstod: dam rdzas sha khrag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'bul: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ba dang : dgra bgegs gnod byed bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces pa'i sham bur srung zlog bsad mnan gyi 'dod gsol yang zlog me'i spu gri ltar btags la bstod do: bzlas pa bya ba ni: snying gar rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba ru: 'od dkar gur nang bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong : zhal nang gzigs te thugs brtses bsrung bar gyur: ces pa ting nge 'dzin gyi srung ba chu bo'i shog dril gyi don no: de'i nang tsitta zur gsum dug rlangs gyur: tsitta'i zur gsum du/ tsitta'i zur gcig mdun du bstan par/ 'jam dpal gser mdog ral gri po ti 'dzin:

zlog pa'i skabs tshig 'di'i tshab tu/ gshin rje dmar nag ral gri zhags pa 'dzin: zhes bsgyur ba ni bzlog pa'i shog dril gyi don no: rta mgrin dmar po thod dbyug sdigs mdzub can: g.yas zur dregs pa mthing nag rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs: dur khrod chas brgyad sgo gsum tsitta zur gsum du zhal nang du gyu nas/ bsrung bar gyur: zhes pa ni ting nge 'dzin gyi shog dril gyi don no: de nang gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu pa: gyen sbreng lte bar ye shes lnga yi gur: de dbus nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor lta bu/ rten 'brel snying po/ dang : dbyangs gsal 'bru gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sngags kyi srad bus phreng ba lta bu/ bsdams pa'o: dbus su nyi zla'i ga'u'i rgyal ba'i thug srog hūm̐ mthing nag: 'di'i ya nṛ hūm̐ gsum ga lañdza khong seng mar sgom dgos pa'i don no: khog par 'jam dpal thugs srog ya dmar nag: lte bar bsrung bya'i bla srog nṛ dmar po: de mthar srung sngags kyis bskor 'od zer 'phros: dus gsum rgyal mchod gshin rje'i lha tshogs bsdus: bsrung bya'i sgrib sbyangs yi ge gsum la thim: zhes pa ting nge 'dzin gyi srung ba ri bo'i shog dril gyi don no: hūm̐ gi klad kor gyi dbus su bla ma dang : dbyer med bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan rdzogs thugs ka yi: 'od kyis 'chi med bdud rtsi bkug byas nas: thugs srog gsum ya nṛ hūm̐ la thim pas tshe dbang thob: ces pa ni ting nge 'dzin srung ba gdeng can gyi shog dril gyi don no: skad cig rdzus skyes ye shes khro bo'i sku: 'od lnga gong du bskyed zin pa'i snang stong 'od kyi sku lta bu 'dzin med dgos pa'i don no: las grub keng rus bde ba'i nyams: dang ldan pa'i khro chu dug gdong nag po sogs sngar bsgoms zin pa lta bu'o/

zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing*/ yi ges mtshan: de las 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs bstims: 'chi med bdud rtsi 'phro 'dus dbang bskur zhing : dwangs ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ drangs pa'i bcud kyis phyi nang khyab: srung byed khro bo'i bdud rtsi nang du 'khyil: srid gsum sgrib sbyangs bde stong phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dbang gi lha'i rnam par rol nas/ ro la spyod: tshe dpal yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur: 'og tu tshe bdud pho mo byad bcings dang : khu sbub gan rkyal bsgyel ba'i snying gar ni: sku smad gnam lcags phur bus gzir byas shing : bsrung bya'i sngon las 'phral rkyen mi mthun phyogs: tshe srog bar gcod sdig sgrib gnod byed bgegs: thams cad 'od zer nag po de la thim: slar yang yig gsum ya nṛ hūm̐/ phreng ba'i sngags kyi 'phro 'du yis: 'jig rten dregs pa rigs drug tshe bdud kyi: sgrib sbyangs ye shes lha yi go 'phang bkod: mthu stobs nus pa bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma lha tshogs thams cad kyi byin rlabs stobs nus rnams/ dpa' bo 'bru lnga oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ'i rnam pa/ dang : a su nṛ pre du trir bcas la rigs drug gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad so so'i sa bon gyi rnam par bsdus: sngags phreng sa bon bcas par thim pa yis: 'khor 'das kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan: phrin las mkhyen brtse tshe bkrag gzi mdangs rgyas: skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i lus su gyur: ces pa ting nge 'dzin srung ba bu ga'i shog dril gyi don no: de ltar sa mā dhi dgu skor gyi man ngag gnad dang bcas pa'i ngang nas bzla bya'i sngags la: dang po rtsa ba'i bsnyen sngags ni: du tri ya ma rā dzaḥ ya ma raksha kro dha pa tsa la kā la rū pa a kro rā dza ya ma rā dza sa ma ya dza dzaḥ

zhes pa ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen sngags yin pas 'di la ci 'grub bzla'o: rtsa sngags 'di la grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni sa ya lnga bzla dgos shing rtags dang sbyar la ma grub bar du 'bad do: ru rakmo raksha ma bhyo dza dzaḥ yum gyi rtsa sngags 'di gong gi sngags sham du btags la stong tsho tsam re bgrang : de las mang mi nyan no: srung zlog gi las shin tu gal che ni rtsa sngags mjug tu yum sngags btags pa'i mthar srung zlog gang byed kyi sham bu btags la bzla'o: 'di shin tu rtsub cing bka' gnyan pas stabs gzab pa gal che'o: dus rtag tu yum sngags 'dogs mi dgos so: srung ba'i dus gong gi sa mā dhi dgu'i ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas: rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la srungs shig nṛ bhrūṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa swā hā: zhes pa ni srung ba'i sngags te srung rtags ma byung bar 'bad dgos so: srung ba'i lag len rnams ni bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril du blta bar bya'o/ ༈ gnyis pa zlog pa ni: rang nyid rgyun 'khyer byed pa'am rtsa ba'i bsnyen sgrub kyi dus dgong mo tsam la zhar byung du zlog pa byed na: dmigs pa kho na la brten pas don 'grub cing : gtor zlog sgrub pa sogs byed na de dag gi bca' gzhi ni lag len shog dril du bshad pa ltar bya dgos so: zlog pa'i dmigs pa ni: rang nyid gshin rje khro chur gsal ba yi: spyi bor gshin rje 'char ka nag po ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mchod rten bsnams pa yis: steng phyogs lha yi gdug pa zlog par byed: mgrin par gshin rje 'joms byed 'bar ba nag: g.yas pas mchod rten g.yon pas dgra sta bsnams: bar snang gnyan gyi gdug pa zlog par byed: snying gar gshin rje tshe bdag nag po ni: zhal gsum g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam: g.yas gsum 'khor lo ral gri rdo rje dang : g.yon gsum lcags kyu gtun shing sdigs mdzub rdeg:

'og phyogs klu yi gdug pa zlog par byed: gsang bar gshin rje kha thun nag po ni: phyag gnyis lcags par bsnams nas dgra sha za: sde brgyad dregs pa'i gdug pa zlog par byed: dpung g.yas gshin rje khrag mtsho khol ma ni: phyag gnyis nyi zla cha lang ltar brdabs pas: byad ma'i sha khrag myal myal rab gtor zhing : dgra gdon pho rgyud tshogs rnams zlog par byed: dpung g.yon gshin rje ral pa tshal dgu ni: mdog nag phyag g.yas khram shing g.yon nad rkyal: thogs nas byad ma lhar bcas khram la 'debs: dgra bgegs mo rgyud tshogs rnams zlog par byed: rang gi ba spu'i gseb nas khro chung tshogs: mtshon thogs grangs med skar ltar 'phros pa yis: byad ma lhar bcas bzlog cing gsod par byed: gshin rje sde drug dug gsum khros pa dang : sprul pa yang sprul 'khor tshogs bcas rnams dang : zhal phyir gzigs nas zlog pa'i las mdzad cing : ba spu'i gseb nas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa: 'phros pas dgra gdon bzlog cing gsod par byed: gur khang phyi rol gnam lcags las grub pa'i: 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng 'og gnyis dang bcu: g.yas su 'khor bas byad ma lha srung bcas: bla srog gcod cing sha khrag gtor bar byed: rtsibs la ma reg tsam du khro chen bcu: shar du gshin rje mthar byed nam mkha'i mdog: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas tho ba bsnams: lho nub shes rab mthar byed dung gi mdog: g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gzir: nub tu padma mthar byed byi ru'i mdog: g.yas pas padma g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gzir: byang du bgegs tshogs mthar byed mu men mdog: g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gzir: shar lhor 'dod rgyal sngo nag g.yas lcags kyu: lho nub dbyug pa sngon po g.yas dbyug to: nub byang stobs chen mthing nag g.yas rdo rje: byang shar mi g.yo mthing nag g.yas ral gri: steng du hūm̐ mdzad sngon po g.yas rdo rje:

'og tu gnod mdzes mthing nag g.yas gtun shing : g.yon rnams sdigs mdzub dgra gdon bgegs tshogs gzir: kun kyang stag sham dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: zhal phyir gzigs nas zlog pa'i las mdzad cing : byad ma lhar bcas rbod gtong byol zor sogs: gzhan gyi sbyor ngan bgegs dang gnod byed tshogs: phar la bzlog cing me lcer sbrang ma ltar: thal bar brlag cing phyi yi rgya mtsho che'i: pha mthar bskrad cing bsad bcad gtub gtor nas: ming yang med par skad cig brlag par gyur: bdag dang lha rnams sku las rang 'dra ba'i: khro tshogs grangs med nad mtshon thog spros pas: byad ma lhar bcas phar zlog bsad cing bsgral: 'byung bzhis tshar bcad lhag rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar: bskrad cing tshar bcad phyir mi ldog par gyur: ces pa'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas: du tri ya ma rā dza/ ya ma raksha/ kro dha pa tsa la/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ya ma sa ma ya ti dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i srog snying la bhyo bhyoḥ zhes pa rnams ni zlog pa'i shog dril bcu gcig gi don no: zhes bzla'o: rtsa sngags la zlog bsad mnan pa'i shog bu 'dogs pa'i tshe/ pa tsa la yan chad ma gtogs kā la rū pa man chad mi dgos pa ni/ rgyud las/ sngags gsum dag gi shog bu ru: zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no: de ltar dmigs pa sngags dang bcas pa zlog pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du 'bad pas bskyed cing zlog pa'i dus kyi lag len rnams ni bca' gzhi lag len shog dril du blta bar bya'o: srung zlog bsad mnan gyi rtags rnams ni gshin rje'i bya lam srung thabs su bshad pa ltar blta bar bya'o: de ltar lus dkyil la lha rnams bkod dgos pa ni: lha de rnams kyi byad du bdag nyid btab pa sogs yod na/ lha de rnams btson du bzung ba'i dgos pa yod cing*/ lha de rnams byad ma kho rang la rang gshed du 'bebs pa yin no/

lus dkyil bkod pa dang*/ khro bo bcu bskyed pa 'di zlog pa'i dus ma gtogs gzhan nam du'ang mi dgos so: de ltar zlog pa'i dmigs pa dang sngags bcas pa 'di ni khro chu'i zlog pa ri rab khong nyul gyi don yin pas/ khro chu mkhan gzhan pa kha shas la gnad 'di mi 'dug cing 'di shin tu zab cing 'tshub pas gzhan snod ldan ma gtogs pa la gsang zhing sba'o: rgya rgya rgya: ༈ gsum pa bsad pa ni: bsad pa'i bca' gzhi dang lag len la sogs pa ni: bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril du blta bar bya'o: dmigs pa ni: mdun du dmigs pa'i dgra bo gsal ba la: rang nyid gshin rjer gsal ba'i thugs srog las: 'od zer 'phros dang bdag gis sngags bzlas pa'i: sgra dang drag po'i thun rnams lhan cig tu: byad ma'i spyi bor lha yi bu yi bdud: sa yi dwangs ma bung ba me tog la: 'jib 'dra de la phog pa de sngangs nas: tshangs pa'i gtsug thag bcad cing lus 'byung 'khrugs: slar yang 'od sngags thun bcas mgrin pa ru: chu yi dwangs ma nyon mongs bdud po ni: sdig pa dmar po brag la 'dzeg 'dra ba: de la phog pas de sngangs rtse chung gnyis: bcad pas byad ma khrag tu skyug par byas: slar yang 'od sngags thun bcas lte ba ru: me yi dwangs ma phung po'i bdud po ni: sdom gzugs dud kha 'dom bsgrad 'dra der phog: de sngangs lte ba'i rtsa bcad lus sems phral: slar yang 'od sngags thun bcas snying kha ru: rlung gi dwangs ma 'chi bdag bdud po ni: mthing nag gyad mi stobs chen 'dra de la: phog pas de sngangs srog gi rtsa bcad nas: lus sems bral zhing srog 'tsho 'gags par byas: slar yang 'od sngags thun bcas spyi bo ru: phog pas sa dwangs mgrin pa'i chu la bsdus: mgrin par phog pas chu dwangs lte ba'i me la bsdus: lte bar phog pas me dang rlung la bsdus: snying khar phog pas rlung de srog rtsar 'dus: rlung gi rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i don no:

de tshe snying khar khrag gi sbal pa ni: byi'u len pa'i mgo tsam de yi nang : rnam shes nṛ yig ljang gur gnas pa las: sbal pa zhu nas rnam shes nṛ la thim: nṛ ljang 'od bcas mar me bsad pa ltar: nag thum song bas bem rig bral zhes pa ni bsad pa'i yig chung khyad par can gyi shog dril nag po'i don no: bar bsam: dmigs pa 'di rgyun 'khyer yin/ gzhan skabs su dmigs pa so so ba rnams kyang bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril du yod pa ltar ro// de ltar dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas bsad pa'i sngags bzla bya ni: du tri ya ma rā dza/ ya ma raksha/ kro dha pa tsa la/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i snying la myog myog yaṃ yaṃ rbad rbad la li tha ba ni: rā dza pra ba ni: dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i snying la myog myog yaṃ yaṃ rbad rbad dza dza ya ya dgra bo'i srog rtsa la rbad rbad/ nag po tsitta srog la breng breng : rtsa tig srog tig rbad: snying tig khaṃ khaṃ raṃ raṃ yaṃ yaṃ byad ma'i snying du sod sod: ces pa'i bsad sngags dmigs pa gsal pa'i ngang nas sgra ma chad par bzla'o: 'di ni srung zlog bsad pa'i ngag 'don du dgos pa rnams bkod pa yin gyi: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor srung zlog bsad pa'i bca' gzhi dang lag len la sogs pa 'jam dpal khro chu sman gdong dug gdong gnyis ka nas nyer mkho lag len du mkho ba rnams bsdus shing de dag la zhal shes kyis brgyan te kho bos bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril du gsal bar bkod yod pas der rtogs par byos shig/ ༈ gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni: bsnyen pa'i dus rang gi mdun du bskyed cing*/ srung zlog bsad pa'i dus gtor chen la dmigs so: de'ang 'di lta ste: mdun gyi rten rnams dang gtor chen bsangs sbyangs byas la: hūm̐ */ chos rnams dmigs med spros bral kun khyab gdal: zhes pa nas/ spyan drangs gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed kyi skabs ji lta ba las:

bdag nyid ces pa'i mal du/ mdun du/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas lha tshogs rnams gsal du bskyed la/ spyan 'dren pa/ bzhugs su gsol ba: phyag 'tshal ba/ phyi'i mchod pa/ bdud rtsi sman mchod/ dug khrag gi mchod pa/ gtor ma'i mchod pa rnams bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar byas la/ bstod pa ni: hūm̐ */ bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dgra bgegs baṃ dang sde brgyad bsnol ba'i steng : khro rgyal gshin rje sku mdog dmar nag 'tsher: zhal gsum phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra sta bsnams: g.yon gsum dgra bo'i snying dang nang khrol gsol: g.yas ljang g.yon dmar dbus mthing mi ro 'cha': dbu skra kham ser mchod rten gsum gyi nang : rigs gsum mgon dang dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams: 'dzum pa'i zhal dang bsrung ba'i las mdzad bzhugs: sku smad khro chu'i phur bu dbal dang ldan: sku stod chu srin rngam zhal sbrul nag 'chang : spu gri chu gri'i gshog pas bar snang gang : sku la dug gi me dpung rab tu 'bar: gsang yum dun tig sbas pa'i tshul du 'khril: 'khor du 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag dang : be wa sa ta za ba ljang dmar dang : ya ma rā dza spyi gshed dug gdong dang : 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dregs pa sgo ba dang : yang 'khor gshin rje dgu khri dgu 'bum sogs: srung dang bzlog cing bsad pa'i las mdzad rnams: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar 'bebs pa yis: yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnal 'byor gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa'i mjug tu srung zlog bsad pa'i sham bu'ang gshin rje yang zlog gi skabs ltar gdag go: slar yang gtso bo la bstod pa rgyas par bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bstod pa 'di la phyogs bcu nam mkha' ma che bar grags so// nyi zla padma dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng :

dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: sku gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje mthu bo che: sku mdog dmar nag bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i cha byad can: g.yas ljang phyag rdor khro chen gtum pa'i zhal: g.yon dmar rta mgrin dbang chen khros pa'i zhal: dbus mthing 'jam dpal drag po khros pa'i zhal: rigs gsum mgon po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbu yi rgyan du bzhugs: nyon mongs dug lnga ye shes lnga ru sbyor: yon tan kun stsol khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa yis: sems dpa' bcu yi thugs dam bskul bar byed: gzi brjid mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: mche ba bcu gnyis rab tu gtsigs pa yis: 'chi bdag bcu gnyis srog rtsa gcod par byed: tshe rgyal rig 'dzin khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: g.yas gsum phyag na dgra sta bsnams pa yis: bstan pa'i ru tra nyes pa sgrol bar byed: bstan srung chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: g.yon gsum phyag na tsitta bsnams pa yis: byang chub lam gyi bar chad sel bar byed: sa lam rab bsgrod khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: spu gri'i gshog pa g.yas su lding ba yis: steng phyogs lha yi tshogs rnams dbang du sdud: dbang sdud mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: chu gri'i gshog pa g.yon pa brkyang ba yis: 'og phyogs klu yi tshogs rnams dbang du sdud: klu dbang rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku sked chu srin rngam zhal gdangs pa yis: bar snang gnyan gyi tshogs rnams dbang du sdud: dmag dpon bdud 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ba spu'i gseb nas rang 'dra'i sprul pa 'gyed: drag po'i phrin las thogs med bsgrub pa'i phyir: rdzu 'phrul mthu mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo: sku las ye shes me dpung 'bar ba ni: snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs sreg par byed:

'dren mchog rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku smad gnam lcags phur bu 'dril ba ni: ngan song gsum gyi skye sgo gcod par byed: sems dpa' chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pa'i mthar srung zlog bsad pa'i skabs su gang bab kyi sham bu 'dod gsol bsgyur ba dang : yang gtso 'khor thams cad la bstod pa ni: hūm̐ ya: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na: las kyi gshin rje'i zhing khams na: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: shin tu 'jigs pa'i pho brang na: steng gi ral gri'i lding khang na: 'og kyang spu gri'i sa gzhi gdal: spu gri chu gri'i gzhal yas su: gru gsum mthing nag bsnol ba'i dbus: dregs chen bco brgyad gnod byed bgegs: dam nyams dgra bo'i gdan steng du: ya las skyes pa'i gshin rje ni: sku mdog dmar nag me ltar 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs: g.yas zhal ljang la g.yon zhal dmar: dbus zhal mthing nag rab tu rngam: nyams pa'i ru tra zhal du gsol: bdud 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbu gsum steng na mchod rten gsum: rigs gsum dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs: srung skyob tshe dbang chos kyi sku: byin rlabs gter gyur khyod la bstod: phyag drug g.yas gsum dgra sta bsnams: dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo lus phral: g.yon gsum snying dang srog rtsa gcod: zhal du gsol mdzad khyod la bstod: sku la dug sbrul chun pos brgyan: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rdul du rlog: mche ba bcu gnyis dug phur gtams: dregs pa kun sgrol khyod la bstod: ljags gsum 'dril zhing rkan sgra rdeb: stong gsum lha 'dre zhal du gsol: zhi bas ma thul ma rungs pa: drag pos sgrol mdzad khyod la bstod: spu gri'i gshog pa g.yas g.yon gyis: gang la dmigs pa rdul du rlog: sku sked chu srin rngam zhal can: stong gsum 'jig rten zhal du gsol: sku smad khro chu'i phur bu yis:

dgra bgegs byad ma'i glo snying gzir: sku la bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar: dgra bgegs byad ma gzhob tu sreg: ba spu'i gseb nas sprul pa 'gyed: dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du rlog: las kyi gshin rje mthu rtsal can: 'khor ni gshin rje 'bum gyis bskor: stong gsum 'jig rten khyab par rgyug: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: sbas pa'i yum chen dun tig dang : 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog gi bdag: be wa sa ta za ba ljang : ya ma rā dza spyi gshed dang : 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: las la myur zhing bstan pa srung : bka' nyan tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byad ma lha srung bcas pa rnams: dbang du bsdus la rdul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma g.yel dam can srung ma'i tshogs: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshig pa dang : dkon mchog gsum la 'tshe ba dang : rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba yi: sdig can dgra 'di myur du sgrol: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces bstod pa rgyas par byas la: srung zlog bsad pa skabs thob gang yin gyi dmigs pa sogs gnad shin tu che bar yod pa ni zhal la dris shig: bdag bskyed kyi dmigs pa srung zlog bsad pa so sor bshad zin la/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs su bdag lhar gsal ba'i thugs srog las 'od 'phros pas mdun bskyed gtso 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gnas pa la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas srung zlog bsad pa gang yin gyi phrin las thogs med du sgrub pa ni zhal shes yin zhing zhib cha tsho ni zhal la dris shig /mchan/ bdag mdun gyi bskyed rim gsal zhing*/ snang grag gsal gsum stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i rol pa las mi g.yo bzhin pa'i ngang nas 'khyer so gsum dang ldan pa'i yid ma yeng bar rtse gcig tu srung zlog bsad pa gang yin gyi dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas bzlas brjod ngag 'chal gyis bar ma chod par byas la bzla'o:

zhib cha mtha' dag bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril du gsal bar yod do: skabs su tshogs kyi mchod pa bya ba ni: tshogs rdzas rnams shin tu tshogs par byas la/ de rnams la chus bran te: oṃ suṃ bha ni'i sngags kyis bsangs: swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyi 'phro 'du las byung ba'i: tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma dag dri ma'i tshogs: bsregs gtor sbyangs shing rnam par dag byas nas: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i rdzas su gyur: ces dmigs la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa ga ṇa tsakra bi shuddhe hūm̐ swā hā: slar yang sman raka bran la: rang nyid lha yi thugs srog las 'phros pa'i: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing 'od 'bar gyis: zhe sdang 'dod chags gti mug las gyur pa'i: tshogs kyi skyon sbyangs sku gsum ngo bor byas: slar yang ha dkar hoḥdamar hrīḥmathing spros: sbyangs spel sbar bas 'dod yon bdud rtsi mchog: gsang sngags dam rdzas rmad byung ye shes tshogs: bla ma yi dam 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes brjod/ tshogs la spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgya mtsho dang : 'jam dpal khro chu dug gdong yab dang yum: sde drug gshin rje las kyi bshan pa dang : bka' 'khor sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'dir gshegs dam rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: tshe dang dbang gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes spyan drangs la/ tshogs phud dang po gtor ma rnams la 'bul zhing sman raka bsgron la: hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal thugs rje che ldan khros pa'i sku: khro bo'i rgyal po khro chu dug gdong dang : sbas pa'i yum chen gsang ba dun tig ma: gshin rje sde drug dug gsum khros pa dang : 'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs la: 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul:

tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes la rnal 'byor la: mchog dang thun mong mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza hoḥ zhes phul la/ tshogs bar pas thugs dam bskang zhing nyams chags bshags pa ni: hūm̐ */ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs kyi mchod pa 'dis: rigs gsum kun 'dus 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi rgya mtsho yis: khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dug khrag rgya mtsho yis: khro chu dug gdong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : ba ling gtor ma brjid ldan 'bar ba yis: las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : phyi nang mchod tshogs nam mkha'i mtha' klas pas: 'jam dpal yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : khyod kyi thugs dam gnyen po des bskangs la: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes bskangs shing nongs gyur bshags pa ni: hūm̐ */ khro rgyal 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol: khyod ni rnam dag ye shes spyan dang ldan: bdag ni nyon mongs dbang gyur 'khrul ba yis: nongs gyur nyams chag gang mchis bzod par gsol: rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma 'dres pa dang : dam rdzas ma tshang bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs: khro rgyal 'khor bcas thugs dang ci 'gal ba: mthol lo bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yi ge brgya pas bshags so// tshogs tha ma bsgral bstab bya ba ni: gtor zlog gdab las sogs dang 'brel na tshogs tha ma 'di ma byas kyang rung la: skabs gzhan du na zan gyi liṅga 'khyud gang pa dgra'i dri ma dang raktas sbags pa/ sha dum/ theb skyu/ chang bu/ gtor chung rnams tshogs kyi sha zan dum gcig dang mnyam du thod pa'am lcags snod du bshams la/ byin gyis ma brlabs pa'i khrag rgod bran la/ dgug gzhug gsum byas la/ mjug tu phur bu thun mtshon lag tu thogs la bskul ba ni:

hūm̐ */ nga ni dpal chen sgrol ging chen po ste: thugs las sprul pa'i gshin rje bshan pa'i tshogs: sa steng sa 'og sa bla'i tshogs gang bas: rdo rje phur bu thun mtshon rab 'bar ba: thogs nas dgra bgegs bla dbugs sems khug la: lha dang phyes la bdud dang gshed du sprod: srog chod dbugs longs mgo lus so sor phrol: sha rus gtubs la bsgral ba'i las mdzod cig: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: thugs dam dus las ma g.yel sa ma ya: zhes dang*/ sngar bshad pa'i bsad sngags bzla zhing thun brab phur bu snying khar gdab cing mtshon gyis gtubs la/ ling ro raktas bran nas lag tu thogs la bstab pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ e ya: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gzugs phung sogs: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bcas: rigs gsum kun 'dus dug gdong yab dang yum: 'khor tshogs dmag dpung rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: bzhes shig rol cig bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: sha ni dbus mthing rngam pa'i zhal du 'bul: dgra bgegs gti mug chos sku'i ngang du sgrol: rus pa g.yas ljang bzhad pa'i zhal du 'bul: dgra bgegs zhe sdang sprul sku'i ngang du sgrol: khrag rnams g.yon dmar gshe ba'i zhal du 'bul: dgra bgegs 'dod chags longs sku'i ngang du sgrol: khams dang klad pa gsang yum zhal du 'bul: dgra bgegs phrag dog ngo bo nyid skur sgrol: zhag dang chu ser nang khrol pags pa dang : lha ba la sogs lhag ma ma lus pa: gshin rje sde drug las kyi bshan pa dang : 'khor tshogs gshin rje'i dmag dpung yongs la 'bul: dgra bgegs nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong dang : mnyam nyid ye shes ngang du sgrol bar mdzod: sha khrag tshogs kyi 'khor lo gsol nas kyang : rnam shes rigs gsum dus gsum rgyal ba yi: zhing du spor la byang chub thob par mdzod: ces 'bul zhing sman raka bsgron la yab yum gyi rtsa sngags mjug tu gtor bsngos kyi skabs ltar sham bu rnams btags la 'bul:

skabs 'dir gsang ba gsol gdab ky-i mnga' gsol bskang ba bya ba ni logs su yod pa ltar skabs 'dir bya: de nas tshogs la longs spyad: lhag ma bsdus la sman raka bran dpal 'bar btsugs la: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dang po phud bdag bla ma gshin rje'i gshed: bar du tshogs bdag dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tha mar lhag sdud las mkhan dmag dpung 'khor: skad cig nyid la 'dir gshegs pha 'bab longs: dang por phud la dbang ba phud la rol: bar du tshogs la dbang ba tshogs la rol: tha ma lhag la dbang ba lhag la rol: sman raka gtor ma dpal gyi pha 'bab dang : dgra bo'i sha khrag rus par bcas pa rnams: bzhes shig rol cig tshim zhing dgyes par mdzod: khyed rnams tshims nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: mi mthun bar chad nad gdon zhi ba dang : tshe dang longs spyod snyan grags rgyas par mdzod: mos bzhis khams gsum srid gsum dbang du bsdus: bstan la gnod byed dmigs pa'i byad ma rnams: srog chod dbugs longs myur du sgrol bar mdzod: dam rdzas sman raka lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs: oṃ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra utstshiṣṭa pa ti bhakṣa khā hi khā hi: zhes gtsang sar 'bul zhing : srung zlog bsad pa'i sgrub pa yun ring byed na lhag ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi 'gram du 'bul lo: bsnyen sgrub kyi dus tshogs mchod 'di nyi ma'i gung thun nam dgong thun la bya dgos so: las kyi mtha' rgyas bstan pa'i rim pa gang byed kyang skabs 'dir bya dgos pas de'i tshul rnams ni bca' gzhi lag len gyi shog dril yod pas der blta bar bya'o// de nas gtor chen yod na sman raka bran zhing dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs la/ dgug gzhug sngags dang bcas pas thugs dam bskul ba ni: e ya: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na: bskul 'di'ang sman gdong gi rgyud le'u sum cu pa las byung ba yin yang 'dra min zhig yong gi 'dug go// nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na:

las kyi gshin rje'i zhing khams nas: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor na: shin tu 'jigs pa'i pho brang ni: steng ni ral gri'i lding khang la: 'og ni spu gri'i sa gzhi ste: bar snang spu gri chu gri dang : mtshon cha bsnol ba'i gur khang dbus: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs baṃ gyi steng : las kyi gshin rje mthu bo che: sku mdog dmar nag me ltar 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i gzugs: g.yas ljang pho rgyud tshogs rnams gsol: g.yon dmar mo rgyud tshogs rnams gsol: dbus mthing byad ma dgra bgegs gsol: dbu gsum steng na mchod rten gsum: rigs gsum dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs: srung skyob tshe dbang chos kyi sku: g.yas gsum dgra sta bsnams pa yis: nyams pa can gyi mgo lus phral: g.yon gsum snying dang srog rtsa bsnams: dregs byed bco brgyad zhal du gsol: sku la gdug pa sbrul gyis brgyan: gdug pa'i tshogs rnams rdul du rlog: mche ba bcu gnyis dug phur gtams: byad ma lha srung don snying gsol: ljags gsum 'khyug cing skan sgra byed: stong gsum lha 'dre zhal du gsol: spu gri'i gshog pa g.yas pa yis: pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas gcod: ral gri'i gshog pa g.yon pa yis: mo rgyud tshogs rnams dmyal thag gcod: sku sked chu srin rngam zhal can: stong gsum mi mjed zhal du gsol: sku smad khro chu'i phur bu yis: byad ma 'bum gyi srog snying gzir: sku la bskal pa'i me 'bar bas: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs gzhob tu sreg: las kyi gshin rje mthu rtsal can: 'khor du gshin rje bye bas bskor: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: gang la dmigs pa rdul du rlogs: dun tig nag mo'i dus la bab: gnod byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs: 'chi bdag nag po'i dus la bab: pho rgyud tshogs rnams rdul du rlogs: tshe bdag dmar po'i dus la bab: mo rgyud tshogs rnams rdul du rlogs: srog bdag nag po'i dus la bab:

snang srid lha 'dre rdul du rlogs: be wa sa ta'i dus la bab: lha srin sde brgyad rdul du rlogs: za ba ljang dmar dus la bab: mu stegs tshogs rnams rdul du rlogs: ya ma rā dza'i dus la bab: phyi nang chos skyong rdul du rlogs: spyi gshed dug gdong dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo rdul du rlogs: khro chu dug gdong dus la bab: thams cad ma lus rdul du rlogs: dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la: byad ma lha srung sde brgyad dang : ban bon mu stegs bshan pa'i tshogs: dregs chen bco brgyad lha 'dre stong : byad ma 'bum dang sde brgyad rnams: skad cig nyid la rdul du rlogs: dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma dang : dgra bo'i sha khrag 'di bzhes la: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: ma g.yel las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi: drag po'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces bskul ring bas bskul: slar bskul thung gis drag tu bskul ba ni: e dza: las kyi gshin rje'i dus la bab: khro chu dug gdong dus la bab: dun tig nag mo'i dus la bab: 'chi bdag nag po'i dus la bab: tshe bdag dmar po'i dus la bab: srog bdag nag po'i dus la bab: be wa sa ta'i dus la bab: za ba ljang dmar dus la bab: ya ma rā dza'i dus la bab: dug gsum khros pa'i dus la bab: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal 'don pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: dam la ma 'da' dam tshig can: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs las la khyer: bla rkun jag pa las la khyer: liṅga 'di ru bkod pa dang : byang bu 'di la btab pa yi: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: gang la dmigs pa khyod kyis shes: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo 'di: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog:

srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: snying khrag hub kyis 'thung la shog: don snying sbar gyis chus la shog: bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog: dgra bo 'khor bcas khug la shog: lha dang phrol la bdud la sprod: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ces gtso 'khor rnams drag tu bskul zhing slar yang phyi 'khor ba rnams bskul ba ni: bhyo ya: gshed chen sde bzhi'i dus la bab: mon pa sde bzhi'i dus la bab: bdud po sde bzhi'i dus la bab: 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dus la bab: pho gshed sum brgya drug cu'i dus la bab: mo gshed sum brgya drug cu'i dus la bab: sha za drug khri drug stong dus la bab: khrag 'thung bye ba sa ya'i dus la bab: sgo ba sde bzhi'i dus la bab: ru tra sde bzhi'i dus la bab: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: dam la ma 'da' dam tshig can: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dus la bab: bla rkun jag pa las la khyer: liṅga 'di ru bkod pa dang : byang bu 'di la btab pa yi: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: gang la dmigs pa khyod kyis shes: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo 'di: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: snying khrag hub kyis 'thung la shog: don snying sbar gyi chus la shog: bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog: dgra bo 'khor bcas khug la shog: lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces thugs dam gnad nas bskul bar bya'o: de nas gtor chen nam thun gtor phyir spags/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs gshin rje'i dmag dpung du gyur nas: mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs par bsams la: gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs la dgug gzhug gsum sogs bya: sman raka bran la dgra bo'i sha khrag tu dmigs la dmag lto'i tshul du dbul:

slar yang gtor ma gshin rje'i dmag tshogs su bsams la: gtor ma rgyag sa'i phyogs de dug gi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su sa rim pa dgu'i 'og mtha' med rgya mtsho'i nang na las kyi bshan pa dug gsum khros pa g.yas seng ge/ g.yon phag zhal can/ dbus chu srin gyi zhal gdangs ba ya 'gal gnam la byas pa lta bu ma 'gal sa la byas ba lta bu/ mche ba gangs ri gtsigs pa ltar: lce glog ltar 'khyugs pa de lta bu kha yar la gdangs nas 'dzed pa'i tshul du yod pa gtor ma gshin rje'i dmag dpung gi dgra bgegs byad ma dmigs bya de dngos su 'dar phril phril yod par bsams la: spyi gshed las kyi bshan pa dug gsum khros pa bskul ba ni zhe sdang drag po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'di skad do: e ya: phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na: gtor chen 'phang pa'i dus sam srung zlog bsad pa'i las gal che ba'i skabs 'di skad do// nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi na: sa rim pa dgu yi mar zhabs na: mtha' med rgya mtsho'i gting zhig na: spyi gshed dug gdong mthu bo che: dug gsum khros pa dgra bgegs gshed: las kyi bshan pa mthu bo che: mthing nag rab 'jigs khro gtum can: zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa'i sku: g.yas pa seng zhal rngam zhing gdangs: g.yon pa phag zhal thur du bsgrad: dbus zhal chu srin ka la sha: ya 'gal gnam la ma 'gal sa: lce ni bar snang glog ltar 'khyug: mche ba zla tshes 'bar bas gtams: spyan mig khrag mtsho kyi li li: g.yas gsum gnam lcags ral gri 'phyar: dam nyams dgra bo'i mgo lus phral: g.yon gsum sbrul nag zhags pa bsnams: dam nyams bla srog yan lag 'ching : dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: zhal du btab bo kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril lo ā ra li: dam nyams dgra bo brlag tu chug: spyi gshed dug gdong dus la bab: las kyi bshan pa'i dus la bab: ya ma rā dza'i dus la bab: dug gsum khros pa'i dus la bab: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab:

sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: mthu rtsal 'don pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo sa ma ya: dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs las la khyer: bla rkun jag pa las la khyer: liṅga 'di ru bkod pa dang : byang bu 'di la btab pa yi: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: gang la dmigs pa khyod kyis shes: yid la gnag pa'i dgra bo 'di: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dam nyams dgra bo gnyid log gi: bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: snying khrag hub kyis 'thung la shog: don snying sbar gyis chus la shog: bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog: lha dang phrol la bdud dang sprod: las kyi bshan pa mthu bo che: spyi gshed dug gdong mthu bo che: dug gsum khros pa mthu bo che: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: ming dang mtshan mar sbyar ba yi: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: skad cig nyid la gyur mid thong : sa rim pa dgu yi 'og tu khyer: mtha' med rgya mtsho'i steng du khyer: gshin yul dme nag nyid du khyer: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bskul zhing gtor ma'i mdun gyi dgra gdon rnams gtor ma dang mnyam du kho'i khar rgyab pas kho'i khar tshud ma thag tu kha btsums te chu srin gyis gyur mid byas nas: kho yang sa 'og rim pa dgu mtha' med rgya mtsho'i pha rol gting gshin yul dme nag tu song nas dgra bo thar ba'i dus med par bsam: mdun gyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams kyang ku sgra bso sgra dang bcas pas dgra'i yul du song nas dgra'i lus dang snying ga'i nang rol du pho brang btab nas: dgra bo dgu rgyud dang bcas pa ming med du ma brlag gi bar du bsdad par bsam zhing rbad par bya'o: de nas gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og tu dgra bgegs 'khor bcas yod par bsams la: dgug gzhug byas la: gtor mnan gyi rta bro bya ba ni:

e ya: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung po lhag rol la: las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs kyis bro brdungs pas: mthing nag rngam zhing 'khrugs pa'i stangs stabs kyis: dgra bgegs gnod byed tshogs rnams ma lus gnon: zhal gsum khro gtum srid pa gsum po gnon: mchod rten gsum gyis khams gsum dgra bgegs gnon: spyan dgu bsgrad pas lha srin sde brgyad gnon: spu gri'i gshog pas byad ma dgra bgegs gnon: chu gri'i gshog pas dregs pa ma lus gnon: sbrul nag chun pos sa bdag klu gnyan gnon: khro chu'i phur pas ru dra pho mo gnon: las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor bcas kyis: dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma lhar bcas kyi: lus ngag yid gsum mnan cing gzir bar mdzod: oṃ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ khaṃ e mā ra ya st+waṃ bha ya nan: zhes rtsa sngags dang mnan pa'i sham bu bro brdung mnan cing gzir ro: de nas 'byor na skabs 'dir dgyes mchod kyi slad du rten gyi drung du sha chen gyi spos bsreg: tshil chen gyi mar me sbar la gsang ba gsol gdab dang mnga' gsol rgyas pa'ang bya'o: de nas bzod par gsol ba ni: hūm̐ */ lha mchog ya mānta ka'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur pas: lta ba ma rtogs sgom pa mthar ma phyin: spyod pa blang dor sku gsung thugs dang 'gal: cho ga chad lhag ma 'byor ma tshang dang : mchod pa chung sogs thugs dang 'gal ba rnams: mthol lo bshags so bzod par myur bzhes la: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes dang : ya ma rā dza'i yi ge brgya pa gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs la: smon lam gdab pa ni: hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal lhag pa'i lha mchog dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod phrin las dang : las 'di brtsams pa'i dge ba dri med 'dis: sangs rgyas bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang : dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang :

dkon mchog rnam gsum dbu 'phang mtho ba dang : dge 'dun thugs mthun bslab gsum chos bcur brtson: rnal 'byor tshe ring bar gcod zhi ba dang : bsod nams dpal rgyas bsam don yid bzhin 'grub: dgra bgegs byad ma rdul du brlag pa dang : bdag gzhan sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog: ces smon lam gdab: nub tha ma yin na gshegs bsdu bya ba ni: hūm̐ */ 'jam dpal khros pa las kyi gshin rje'i tshogs: rnal 'byor bdag cag bsam pa'i don sgrub cing : bar chad dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral zin nas: slar yang rang bzhin gnas su gshegs nas kyang : ji ltar gang tshe bdag gis spyan drang na: de tshe slar yang myur du 'byon par gsol: badzra mu: dam tshig dkyil 'khor mtha' nas rim gyis bsdu: mtshon cha srung 'khor la thim de nyid kyang : gzhal yas la bsdu de yang 'khor la bsdu: de yang spyi gshed la thim de nyid kyang : sde drug gshin rjer thim zhing de rnams kyang : yum la bsdus shing yum yang yab la thim: yab kyang sku lus stod smad 'od zhu nas: thugs ka'i sa bon la thim de nyid kyang : dmigs med gsal stong brjod bral ngang nyid las: slar yang gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku ru gyur: ces pa'i bsdu rim rnams byas la: shis pa brjod pa ni: hūm̐ */ ma rig dug gi dug chen po: dug gdong nag po'i bkra shis shog: rig pa ye shes chen po'i sman: sman gdong chen po'i bkra shis shog: 'jam dpal stong nyid khro chu'i mkhar: khro chu dug gdong bkra shis shog: dbu gsum steng na mchod rten nang : rigs gsum mgon po'i bkra shis shog: g.yon dmar rta mgrin dbang gi sku: dbang sdud rgyal po'i bkra shis shog: g.yas ljang phyag rdor gtum po'i sku: dregs pa 'dul ba'i bkra shis shog: dbus mthing 'jam dpal khro bo'i sku: las kyi gshin rje'i bkra shis shog: gsang chen dgyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir: sbas pa'i yum gyi bkra shis shog:

'jam dpal sku las sprul pa'i sras: 'chi bdag nag po'i bkra shis shog: rta mgrin gsung las sprul pa'i sras: tshe bdag dmar po'i bkra shis shog: phyag rdor thugs las sprul pa'i sras: srog bdag nag po'i bkra shis shog: yon tan ma lus yongs rdzogs pa: be wa sa ta'i bkra shis shog: phrin las mtha' yas lhun grub pa: za ba ljang dmar bkra shis shog: gnyis med thugs las sprul pa'i sras: ya ma rā dza'i bkra shis shog: dug gsum sku gsung thugs su sbyor: las kyi bshan pa'i bkra shis shog: dgra bgegs byad ma bsgral ba'i phyir: 'khor gyi gshin rje'i bkra shis shog: mi mthun bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir: bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog: dbul phongs nyes tshogs las skyob phyir: dam can tshogs kyi bkra shis shog: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang : dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang : bstan 'dzin sku tshe legs brtan pa: bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog: dgra gdon gnod byed bsgral ba dang : tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa sogs: rnal 'byor bsam pa 'grub pa yi: bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog: gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i lam: 'jam dpal chos 'di phyogs kun tu: dar rgyas 'gro don lhun grub pa'i: bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog: ces sogs kyi bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs par brjod par bya'o: de nas nang gtor rnams gtor 'bul bya bar 'dod na phyi nang snga bar lha so so'i bstod bskul gyis sgrub khang steng du 'bul: las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ */gshin rje sde drug la kha cig gis zhal gsum phyag drug pa byas pa 'dug kyang*/ gtso bo dang spyi gshed sde drug la zhal gsum phyag drug byas pa sngar gyi las byang gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha rnying pa rnams dang : gzhan yang yig cha khungs thub mang rabs dang : sman gdong gi rgyud le'u sum cu so lnga pa dang :

rje btsun ratna'i phyag bris kyi thang ka sogs gang la'ang mi 'dug pas de ni cung zad ma dag pa kho nar mngon no: khro chu yum dang sbyor ba 'di gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa yin pas shin tu zab pa khyad par du 'phags pa yin zhing : 'di las byang gzhan dang khro chu mkhan phal cher la mi 'dug pas gsang zhing sba bar bya'o: de ltar khro chu dug gdong gi las byang gdug pa kun sgrol zhes bya ba 'di gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang : rje btsun ratnas mdzad pa gdug pa tshar gcod gtso bor byas nas: sman gdong gi rgyud dang : zlog pa ri rab khong nyul dang : bsad pa khyad par can gyi shog dril sogs skabs su bab pa'i man ngag zab khyad can rnams kyis kha bskangs te/ 'bri gung pa gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas gzhu smad spro lung du sbyar ba rdzogs so// 'di la bcos slad ma byed cig: sa ma ya rgya: bka' rgya: dam rgya: gsang rgya:
